title: THRU (Digitone exclusive audio)
author: irpina
description: THRU, the smallest exclusive-audio mod for the Digitone mk1: THRU in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) gives it the output, and the audio inputs go straight there at knob A's level while the synths are silent; NO gives the output back. A template for a mod that wants the whole audio engine: it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Exclusive audio"). Needs core-dn1 3.2.
